primaryTextChecks.text: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

contextChecks.before: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.
contextChecks.after: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.
